dct_description_sm: Ocean Networks Canada (ONC) is a not-for-profit society that operates and manages innovative cabled observatories on behalf of the University of Victoria that supply continuous power and Internet connectivity to various scientific instruments located in coastal, deep-ocean, and Arctic environments. The data were collected as a part of the Community Observatory project in Cambridge Bay in an effort to improve understanding of physical and bio-geochemical processes related to marine ecosystems and how these affect local communities.
dct_title_s: Community Observatory: Ice Profile Data from Cambridge Bay, Canada, deployed August 2016
